verdict.rationale: Unleash's own marketing says flags can 'kill anything AI ships, in real time and without redeploys,' which is a first-party claim that changes reach the application quickly. The evidence pack never documents the mechanism: no streaming connection, no polling interval and no propagation latency figures. The Edge caching layer speaks to read scalability, not delivery speed. Missing for 10: documented streaming or polling mechanism, stated propagation latency or SDK refresh interval, hands-on or independent confirmation that a kill switch takes effect within seconds.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills

citations.quote: Release, experiment, and kill anything AI ships, in real time and without redeploys.
They allow you to enable and disable features for certain users without having to redeploy your application.
